offer.text: They say there's a city buried in the deep dark, older than any village. I'm too long in the tooth to reach it — but you? Step inside its walls and tell me it's real.

accept.text: Tread softly down there. Some things sleep, and ought to keep sleeping.

decline.text: Wise, perhaps. The deep dark keeps what it takes.

in_progress.text: Have you found the ancient city yet? Mind the dark — and the silence.

ready.text: You stood inside it? Truly? Tell me everything.

complete.text: An ancient city, walked and survived. You've done what I only ever dreamed. Take this — you've more than earned it.
